text: 近期人民币持续走强，11月3日中国人民银行果断出手上调金融机构外汇存款准备金率，稳定市场预期，维护外汇市场平稳运行。上调外汇存款准备金率，收紧境内美元流动性，缓解人民币升值压力；在人民币汇率过快贬值时，可下调外汇存款准备金率，缓解人民币贬值压力。历史上，中国人民银行曾多次调整外汇存款准备金率。2021年央行两次上调外汇存款准备金率至9%；2022年至2023年，央行三次下调外汇存款准备金率至现行的4%。
text_en: The renminbi has strengthened continuously recently. On November 3, the PBOC acted decisively to raise the foreign exchange deposit reserve ratio of financial institutions, stabilizing market expectations and maintaining the smooth operation of the foreign exchange market. Raising the FX deposit reserve ratio tightens domestic US dollar liquidity and eases upward pressure on the renminbi; when the renminbi depreciates too quickly, the ratio can be lowered to ease depreciation pressure. Historically, the PBOC has adjusted the FX deposit reserve ratio multiple times. In 2021, the central bank raised it twice to 9%; from 2022 to 2023, it lowered the ratio three times to the current 4%.
